title: NEVER ENOUGH KIZOMBA FESTIVAL #5 – GENEVA ALL IN ONE
description:
♾️ NEVER ENOUGH KIZOMBA FESTIVAL – ALL IN ONE ♾️
💥 From January 8th to the 10th 2027, Kizomba Geneva welcomes you to an friendly festival in a festive and family atmosphere 🎉 3 Rooms, 3 Atmospheres 🤩
🔥 Exceptional setting in a 4 stars hotel between lake and mountains, 10′ minutes away from Geneva airport (free shuttles) and train station at the bottom of the hotel⛰ 🛬–> Parties til 6:00am 🕕🎵
